eval.title: Apple Stock is Very Risky

call.headline_quote: Therefore, no value now in Apple.

base_metric.name: eps
base_metric.quote: earnings 8.26 26 per share has been doing really great lately

scenarios.name: normal
scenarios.quote: I have put a 7% growth rate because Apple didn't grow that much over the previous five years... I've put a P ratio of 20 down the road. Intrinsic value is 40% of the current stock price.

scenarios.name: best
scenarios.quote: let's say 12% over the next five years and then 7% discount rates my expected return 10% terminal multiple 25 then I'm still 33% below the current stock price

scenarios.name: worst
scenarios.quote: let's say Apple grows just 5% because of new technologies, competition, who knows this country terminal multiple 12... you can see your investment being down 60% over the next 10 years

what_is_priced_in.quote: But that singledigit growth is yes, Apple is a great business. Yes, everything. But if they reach that singledigit growth, that's it.

reasons.claim: In his normal growth case Apple is worth only 40% of today's price, and even in an optimistic case it is 33% overvalued.
reasons.quote: Intrinsic value is 40% of the current stock price.

data_check.gap_note: he says 40, as-of 135.09 (T0); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: Recent 22% EPS growth is not sustainable since the underlying business, not just the stock, hasn't grown that fast over five years.
reasons.quote: Now they are growing at 22% but I'm wondering whether that is sustainable.

data_check.gap_note: he says 22, as-of 7.46 (FY2025); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: Wall Street analysts themselves project only high single-digit to low double-digit growth going forward, which he says is not enough to justify the price.
reasons.quote: if we look at projected growth, you can see here that yes, 17 going forward, not 22, then nine, 12 depending on the number of analysts.

data_check.gap_note: not in our data: analyst projected growth

reasons.claim: Buybacks now yield only 2-3% because the stock price is so high, so they add little value despite pushing the price up via flows.
reasons.quote: The buybacks given the huge high stock price now give a 2 3% yield.

reasons.claim: Buffett/Berkshire selling most of its Apple position signals the price has become too exuberant even for a quality business.
reasons.quote: Buffett has been selling Birkshshire most of their position. They still hold it.

external_facts_used: Wall Street analyst ratings (mostly buy, some hold) and price targets on Apple
Wall Street analyst projected forward growth rates (17%, 9-12%)
Berkshire Hathaway's reported selling of most of its Apple position

critic.notes: He explicitly says 'Apple is a sell' (repeated for two years), so 'short' fits better than 'avoid'; both map to SELL, so no material disagreement.
